derivation:
by
  change SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf K K R).symm r) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K K 1) = r
  simpa using SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply ((LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf K K R).symm r) (1 : K)
